user_review.method: Fresh agent metadata-first predictions, three actual generated conversation turns on synthetic inputs and one revised-turn regeneration; separately labeled no-tool/pending/recall/exit simulations. Root browser tested offline examples and clipboard after CUA runtime recovery. No real user trial, live automatic routing or actual chat creation.

scenarios.request: Independent maker waits for a real API failure investigation; wants three minutes of broader reflection.
scenarios.expected: Offer a few distinct open questions, preserve the technical issue and let the user choose.
scenarios.observed: Fresh skill-text agent generated three open questions about viewer experience, evidence for design choices and a tentative tradeoff. It acknowledged HTTP 429 as technical and invited one fragment without a timer.

scenarios.request: The maker notices a tension between thoughtful viewing and daily visits, but has not decided what to change.
scenarios.expected: Synthesize actual words and project state without deciding; offer a specific optional new chat.
scenarios.observed: Initial reply preserved uncertainty but added a frequency-framed exercise and only offered prompt preparation. Narrow instructions were refined; regeneration kept the maker’s value question, preserved the active API owner, and directly offered a focused chat with alternatives.

scenarios.request: Prepare content for a new chat; explicitly do not open one or decide feature changes.
scenarios.expected: A portable starter preserving purpose, current state, uncertainty and exploration-only scope.
scenarios.observed: Generated starter carried the user’s own reflection, unfinished decisions, technical issue and owner, and missing evidence; no actual chat creation or project edit occurred.

scenarios.request: User consents but no creation tool exists; or a tool reports setup pending.
scenarios.expected: Distinguish a ready prompt, submitted creation and a ready chat; avoid fake success and duplicate creation.
scenarios.observed: Labeled text simulations retained a copy-ready fallback with no-tool disclosure, and reported a synthetic pending response as pending. No live host creation was tested.

scenarios.request: Old note has unknown later status; or user wants to stare into space / return to agent.
scenarios.expected: No invented inaction, guilt or mandatory recap; immediate exit.
scenarios.observed: Labeled simulations used unknown-status wording and ended immediately for rest or return. No actual history lookup was performed.

scenarios.request: Gap/three-minute reflection requests versus week planning or discussion of the skill itself.
scenarios.expected: Apply only to relevant reflective gap use.
scenarios.observed: Metadata-first reviewer predicted matches for both gap requests and exclusions for week planning and product-positioning discussion; live automatic routing untested.

scenarios.request: Switch fictional examples; edit/copy starter; export old and malformed v1 data.
scenarios.expected: Complete reflection/synthesis/invitation examples, working handoff text and unchanged legacy export.
scenarios.observed: Node DOM harness passed examples, keyboard tabs, editable starter propagation, copy/fallback and exact valid/malformed/empty legacy export. After runtime reconnect, root actually verified example switching, context input, CC prefix, clipboard result and readable question/answer/context/handoff in IAB; screenshot saved. Mobile and direct-file rendering untested.

similar_skills.learned: Move from the person’s own reflection to a faithful synthesis, retaining their wording. Main instruction file fully read; referenced examples not read.
similar_skills.reason: Use a brief thought/context synthesis and explicitly preserve uncertainty. Reject compulsory single-question tutoring, continued probing of fragments, and a full knowledge document.

similar_skills.learned: Start from context; distinguish evidence, inference, observed behavior and decisions; carry uncertainty into handoff. Main instruction file fully read.
similar_skills.reason: Carry these distinctions into optional focused chat preparation and preserve existing authority. Reject requiring every question to change implementation; a philosophical perspective alone is valid.

validation.observed: Companion checks passed: three complete fictional examples, keyboard navigation, editable starter, clipboard/fallback, untouched legacy export, offline/accessibility structure.
